description.en: Offline search in images, scanned and mixed PDFs, and images embedded in Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Incremental indexing with highlighted previews. Once indexed, type the picture's words straight into the search box.
description.zh: 离线搜索图片、扫描与混排 PDF、Word / PPT / Excel 内嵌图片中的文字。选择目录，后台增量识别，预览高亮命中位置。建好索引后直接在搜索框输入图片里的文字即可搜到。

notes.zh: 装了增强文字识别的较大模型或自己的模型（Win顺 0.48.0，设置 › 剪贴板）时用它识别，能读日文；已经索引过的图片不会自动重读。图标按容器排版。权限不变。
notes.en: Reads with the larger or your own enhanced OCR model when one is installed (WinShun 0.48.0, Settings › Clipboard), Japanese included; pictures already indexed are not read again by themselves. Icons are laid out by their container. Permissions unchanged.
